key_provisions: Terminates the national emergency declared on February 1, 2025, in Executive Order 14193.
Uses the authority provided under section 202 of the National Emergencies Act.

summary_detail.significance: The bill officially ends a specific national emergency related to Canadian imports and the associated tariffs, returning trade rules to how they stood before the emergency declaration.
